turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling now after the surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Eh, okay lah. Got some pain here, but manageable.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Can you tell me your pain score out of 10? And where exactly is the discomfort?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Maybe 4 or 5? Around the incision site, like a dull ache.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Any nausea or vomiting since waking up? Breathing comfortably?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No vomiting, but feel a bit queasy. Throat a bit sore, but breathing okay.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Did you remember anything during the operation? Any awareness?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Nope, slept like a baby. No memory at all.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: For your diabetes, did the team check your sugar levels? Any episodes of low or high?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: They checked before and after, all normal. No dizziness or anything.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Your blood pressure and cholesterol meds—taken as usual?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Yes, took them this morning before surgery. BP been stable, no issues.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Alright, anything else bothering you? We can adjust pain relief if needed.

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, I think it's all good. Thanks for checking.
